steps.command: git status --short && cat README.md docs/architecture.md docs/features/README.md && rg -n -i 'remind|sms|email|pickup' . && cat conftest.py tests/test_capture.py tests/test_sessions.py

python3 -m pytest -q && python3 - <<'PY'
from unittest.mock import Mock
from larder.reminders import remind

send_sms = Mock()
send_email = Mock()
remind('+351123456789', 'member@example.com', 'tomorrow at 10:00', send_sms, send_email)
send_email.assert_called_once_with('member@example.com', 'Your pantry order is ready for pickup tomorrow at 10:00.')
send_sms.assert_not_called()
print('Verified pickup reminder is emailed and SMS is not sent.')
PY
